item.title: UBL and Meezan Bank lead Pakistan’s Largest Private Sector Islamic Financing of PKR 133 Billion
item.description: United Bank Limited (UBL) as one of the Mandated Lead Advisors & Arrangers, has successfully led Pakistan’s largest private sector syndicated Islamic financing to date, totaling PKR 133 billion.
